{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the column names and values
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Unique values in 'arm':", df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique values in 'responded':", df['responded'].unique())

# Check the response distribution in the TREATMENT arm
treatment_df = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']
response_counts = treatment_df['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False)

# Calculate the fraction of responders
n_responders = response_counts.get(1, 0)
n_total = len(treatment_df)
fraction_responded = n_responders / n_total

print(f"Number of patients in TREATMENT arm: {n_total}")
print(f"Number of responders: {n_responders}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Return the fraction
fraction_responded"}
